semantics.frame: rAF callback intervals, not physical frames
semantics.rtt: application send to correlated response, including scheduling and server work
semantics.traffic: UTF-8 V2 application payload bytes; no wire overhead or HTTP assets

semantics.presentation: matching revision at next rAF opportunity after commit, not physical display; transcript required
semantics.feedback: input to next rAF opportunity after pending-state commit; provisional movement feedback is separate from authoritative presentation
semantics.unavailable: Absent samples stay absent. Long Tasks/LoAF depend on browser support. Renderer cadence unavailable.
